metadata.description: Claude Code Telegram channel with voice STT/TTS support

plugins.name: telegram-voice
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code with DashScope STT and MiniMax TTS voice support

plugins.name: feishu-voice
plugins.description: Feishu (飞书) channel for Claude Code mirroring telegram-voice; M1 text echo, voice/files to follow

plugins.name: slice-channel
plugins.description: Local push-based IPC between a main Claude session and its forked slices (self-fork mechanism). Per general/self_fork_skill_dev/design.md §7.

plugins.name: html-channel
plugins.description: Bridge between an HTML page's embedded chat box and a Claude Code slice — chat-edit a web page live (sibling of slice-channel). Per general/html_channel_dev/DESIGN.md.

plugins.name: channel-client
plugins.description: UNIFIED thin MCP client for channel-msg-broker — single Unix-socket conn carrying BOTH Telegram and HTML-channel tool surfaces over LINE-JSON to /tmp/channel-msg-broker.sock. Primary tool send_message(channel, target, content, files?, ...) + back-compat wrappers reply / html_reply. Specialized TG: react / voice_reply / download_attachment / edit_message / send_typing. HTML-namespaced subscription-admin: html_bind / html_unbind / html_list_pages / html_self / channel_self. No grammy, no upstream polling, no proxy.
